properties.displayName: UAV S35 - Credential Theft Espionage Pattern (Anomalous Geo/Device)
properties.description: 국가배후 APT(APT28류) 자격증명 탈취 특징 탐지 — 브루트포스 볼륨이 아닌 '정상적으로 성공한' 로그인 중 Approved_Device_Fingerprint_List에 없는 기기 지문(DeviceFingerprint) 또는 운영자 승인 지역(ApprovedCountry)과 다른 접속 지역(GeoCountry)을 탐지. 두 조건이 동시에 만족되면 탈취된 자격증명의 원격 사용으로 신뢰도 상향. MITRE: T1078
properties.query:
let alertWindow = 15m;
let ApprovedFp =
    _GetWatchlist('Approved_Device_Fingerprint_List')
    | project OperatorId, ApprovedFingerprint = DeviceFingerprint, ApprovedCountry;
UAVOpAudit_CL
| where TimeGenerated > ago(alertWindow)
| where EventType == "login_success"
| join kind=leftouter (ApprovedFp) on $left.Operator == $right.OperatorId
| extend isKnownFingerprint = isnotnull(ApprovedFingerprint) and DeviceFingerprint == ApprovedFingerprint
| extend isKnownCountry = isnotnull(ApprovedCountry) and GeoCountry == ApprovedCountry
| where not(isKnownFingerprint) or not(isKnownCountry)
| extend TriggerReason = case(
    not(isKnownFingerprint) and not(isKnownCountry), "자격증명탈취_의심_미승인기기_이상지역_동시",
    not(isKnownFingerprint), "자격증명탈취_의심_미승인_DeviceFingerprint",
    "자격증명탈취_의심_이상_접속지역"
)
| extend ConfidenceLevel = iff(not(isKnownFingerprint) and not(isKnownCountry), "High", "Medium")
| extend DetectionDetail = strcat(
    "Operator:", Operator,
    "|DeviceFingerprint:", DeviceFingerprint,
    "|ApprovedFingerprint:", tostring(ApprovedFingerprint),
    "|GeoCountry:", GeoCountry,
    "|ApprovedCountry:", tostring(ApprovedCountry)
)
| extend UAVId = "SOC-AUTH"
| project TimeGenerated, UAVId, Operator, TriggerReason, ConfidenceLevel, DetectionDetail, DeviceFingerprint, GeoCountry, ClientIp
| sort by TimeGenerated desc

alertDetailsOverride.alertDisplayNameFormat: UAV S35 - Credential Theft Espionage Pattern - {{Operator}}
